item.text: {"critiques":[{"candidate_id":"refactor-baseline-v1","result":{"findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"legacy_route duplicates the routing logic instead of delegating directly to route_request.","evidence":"routing.py:14-19 contains a separate route table and lookup.","claim_ids":["x1","d1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"dispatch and dispatch_batch still call legacy_route instead of route_request directly.","evidence":"routing.py:23 and routing.py:27 call legacy_route.","claim_ids":["c1","s1"]}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}},{"candidate_id":"release-policy-baseline-v1","result":{"findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality does not use hmac.compare_digest.","evidence":"release_policy.py:14 compares digests with !=.","claim_ids":["x1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths, and malformed inputs can raise exceptions instead of failing closed.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16-18 performs startswith without validating roots, paths, or record shape; a change missing \"path\" raises KeyError.","claim_ids":["x2","x5"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Root containment uses a raw string prefix, so a sibling path can be accepted.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 accepts path \"foobar/file\" under root \"foo\".","claim_ids":["x3"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources are never checked, and unknown actions are ignored.","evidence":"release_policy.py:18 reads only change[\"path\"]; a rename from an out-of-scope source to an in-scope destination can pass.","claim_ids":["x4","x5"]}],"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested"}}],"schema_version":1}
